narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Bend all four arms to the right and it will have only two angles of symmetry.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Turn it by a quarter turn, and the top arm lands on the right arm.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Every arm bends the same way, so it still fits, and all four turns work.
